topics.title: Introduction: factors of production and land
topics.ncert_sections: Introduction; Factors of Production; Land (natural resources)

concepts.learning_objective: Define factors of production and name the four types along with technology as a facilitator.
Explain that land in economics includes all natural resources used in production.

topics.title: Labour, human capital and its facilitators
topics.ncert_sections: Labour (human resources); People as a resource; Facilitators of human capital

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish labour as effort from human capital as the skills and quality of that effort.
Explain how education, training, healthcare and work culture build human capital.

topics.title: Challenges to human capital and India's ancient skill heritage
topics.ncert_sections: Challenges to human capital; India's ancient skill heritage

concepts.learning_objective: Analyse challenges to human capital and the conditions for a demographic dividend.
Describe India's traditional skill systems such as the shilpa shastras and stitched shipbuilding.
Identify capital as money plus human-made durable assets used in production.
Explain how businesses raise capital through savings, bank loans and the stock market.
Describe the tasks of an entrepreneur, including taking risks and combining factors.
Explain what a startup is and why entrepreneurs such as J.R.D. Tata served society.
Explain technology as applied scientific knowledge and how it changes production.
Explain how platforms like SWAYAM and National Career Service widen access to skills and jobs.

topics.title: How the factors are connected and responsibilities towards them
topics.ncert_sections: How are the Factors Connected?; Responsibilities towards Factors of Production

concepts.learning_objective: Analyse how factors combine in different proportions in labour- and capital-intensive production.
Explain what a supply chain is and how its disruption can halt production.
Describe producers' responsibilities to the environment and workers, including CSR.
